answer: Resist Sybils with a compute-reservation pool: every identity must lock a slice of real GPU capacity in a shared nebula of compute, proven by a random benchmark pulse every epoch. A newcomer holds one slice; an attacker running 100 fakes must reserve 100 slices, about 400 GPU-hours per epoch, and any slice failing its pulse is seized and its 20-unit bond burned. Identity cost becomes shale-hard: real hardware, not free names, so a fake swarm pays roughly 2,000 units per epoch just to stay alive.
